sentences.en: They were clearing the snow from the sidewalk with a shovel.
sentences.zh: 他们正在用铲子清理人行道上的雪。

sentences.en: I walked by a little girl playing jumprope on the sidewalk.
sentences.zh: 我走过一个小女孩在人行道上跳绳的地方。

sentences.en: Around here, they roll up the sidewalks at 7 o'clock.
sentences.zh: 这里的人们习惯于晚上七点后关闭商店，这句话是夸张的说法，意思是大多数店铺都关门了。
